newsitem.title: UK: Glencore zinc profile up on Metaleurop buy.
newsitem.headline: Glencore zinc profile up on Metaleurop buy.

text.p: Switzerland's Glencore group has further increased its profile in the zinc market by exercising an option to buy a 10.4 percent stake in France's Metaleurop SA from Germany's Preussag AG.
Traders said the purchase, along with other recent developments, means that the Swiss commodity trader could be as big a player in zinc as it was in aluminium in the 1980s.
Glencore has been involved as a strategic partner with Metaleurop since late 1995, and increases its stake through the purchase to 25.4 percent.
Earlier this month, Spain's Banco Espanol de Credito (Banesto) closed a deal to sell its 24.79 percent stake in Asturiana to Glencore, making the Swiss company the main shareholder.
Glencore also controls Peru's Iscaycruz 125,000-tonne a year zinc mine, which commmenced production last year.
